g.text: Freebase relation groups across life periods
* All sampled Layer 0 messages retained. Grey cells (—): no sampled messages.
Rows sum to 100% over observed groups. Original and generated reverse directions combined.
Test roots, seed 42, fanouts 15/10. A person may appear in more than one period graph.
